display.purpose: Screen-level headings. Page titles on dashboard and marketing surfaces.

headline.purpose: Section titles and modal headers. One per surface maximum.

title.purpose: Subsection heads, card titles, sidebar section labels.

body.purpose: All running copy, descriptions, and form help text. Cap at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Metadata, timestamps, status values, badge text, input labels.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus affordance on interactive elements. Not a decorative shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring-muted
shadows.purpose: Secondary focus ring on inputs, 30% opacity for visual softness.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions. Exits fast, never bounces.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color/opacity transitions on hover and focus.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Layout shifts like progress bar width changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Deep Teal background, Cream text. Used for the most important action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1A4D52; color: #FAF7F0; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #143A3E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FAF7F0, 0 0 0 4px #1A4D52; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary navigation actions. Transparent at rest, Border-tinted on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1A1A1F; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #E2DDD4; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #E2DDD4; border-color: #C8C2B6; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1A4D52; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Badge — Free
components.description: Tier badge for free plan users. Neutral, does not call attention.
components.css: .ds-badge-free { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #E2DDD4; color: #6B7A7B; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.4; }

components.description: Tier badge for Pro plan. Surface background with Deep Teal text — signals active plan without emphasis.
components.css: .ds-badge-pro { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #FDFCF9; color: #1A4D52; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #E2DDD4; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Badge — Unlimited
components.description: Tier badge for Unlimited plan. The one context where Amber enters a badge element.
components.css: .ds-badge-unlimited { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #F5EFE4; color: #7A5C30; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #E8D9BF; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Quota Progress Bar
components.description: Displays monthly cloud synthesis quota usage. Teal fill up to 80%; Error red above 80%. Requires full ARIA attributes.
components.html: 195 min used of 300 min
components.css: .ds-quota { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-quota-bar { height: 6px; width: 100%; background: #E2DDD4; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-quota-fill { height: 100%; background: #1A4D52; border-radius: 9999px; transition: width 250ms cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0); } .ds-quota-fill[data-warning] { background: #C0392B; } .ds-quota-label { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; color: #6B7A7B; line-height: 1.4; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-quota-fill { transition: none; } }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container. Surface background on Cream page, Border outline, 12px radius. No shadow.
components.html:
Cloud synthesis this month

105 min remaining
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FDFCF9; border: 1px solid #E2DDD4; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6B7A7B; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-value { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1A1A1F; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar or list navigation items. Ghost at rest, Teal text + surface background on active.
components.html: ArchiveCalendar
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #1A1A1F; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #E2DDD4; } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #1A4D52; background: oklch(93% 0.008 194); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1A4D52; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-item { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Sonabrief's interface is a private professional space — quiet, ordered, and precise. The visual language is not warm and approachable; it is trusted and competent. Where a consumer product might use softness to lower resistance, Sonabrief uses clarity to signal that something serious is happening here. Every screen should feel like opening a well-organized brief: the right information in the right place, nothing else present.

The palette is restrained: Deep Teal anchors surfaces and actions; Cream provides a warm but serious backdrop; Amber surfaces rarely, only where something needs to be noticed (quota warnings, upgrade moments, unlimited status). Instrument Serif gives headings authority without heaviness. Manrope keeps body copy professional and readable at small sizes without the cold neutrality of a geometric sans.

This system explicitly rejects: Notion and Coda's casual collaborative-wiki aesthetic; the "friendly startup" softness of generic SaaS cream products with rounded-everything layouts; the consumer meeting-recorder look of tools like Otter.ai and Fireflies; and the intimidating density of heavy enterprise UI.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color strategy: Teal and Cream carry the surface; Amber is used in ≤10% of any screen
Serif headings with structured sans body — authority and legibility, not decoration
Flat surfaces with tonal depth, no decorative shadows
Left-aligned, structured layouts on app screens; center-alignment reserved for auth and error states
Precise, expert copy: no exclamation marks, no marketing adjectives in the UI

rules.name: The Amber Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Amber is a signal, not a palette member. It appears on at most one element per screen. If two things need to be amber, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Chromaless Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Pure #000 and #fff are prohibited. Every neutral is tinted toward the brand hue. Charcoal carries a cooler undertone; Cream and Surface carry a warm one. Zero-chroma neutrals fail the trusted workroom atmosphere.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface has a shadow at rest. Shadow may appear only as a focus ring, never as ambient decoration. If a component needs a shadow to feel elevated, rethink whether cards are the right affordance for that content.

rules.name: The Mixed Authority Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif owns hierarchy. Manrope owns density. They do not share roles: do not set a paragraph in Instrument Serif and do not set a page heading in Manrope.

rules.name: The Scale Contrast Rule
rules.body: Adjacent text elements must differ by at least 1.25× in size OR at least one weight step. Flat scales produce walls of text that read as bureaucratic.

dos: Do use Deep Teal (#1A4D52) as the structural primary — for buttons, active states, brand wordmark, and quota fill.
Do reserve Amber (#C89868) for Unlimited status and >80% quota warnings. One Amber element per screen, maximum.
Do use Instrument Serif exclusively for headings (Display and Headline roles). Manrope for everything else.
Do tint every neutral toward the brand hue. Surface is #FDFCF9, not #FFFFFF. Charcoal is #1A1A1F, not #000000.
Do use tonal layering for depth: Cream → Surface → Border, in that order, as surfaces nest.
Do left-align content on authenticated app screens.
Do add role="progressbar" and full ARIA attributes to the quota bar.
Do include @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) on every CSS transition and animation.
Do cap body copy at 65-75ch line length.
Do use weight contrast (≥1.25 ratio between adjacent hierarchy steps) alongside size to create visual hierarchy.
Do write button copy in the imperative: "New meeting", "Manage subscription". No informal + prefix on primary CTAs.
donts: Don't use #000000 or #ffffff anywhere. Every neutral is tinted.
Don't use border-left or border-right thicker than 1px as a colored accent on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient). Single solid color for all text.
Don't display a hero metric template (big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent).
Don't render identical-sized cards in an icon + heading + text grid.
Don't reach for a modal as the first solution.
Don't mix Tailwind's generic semantic colors (bg-teal-50, text-teal-700, text-amber-700) with the brand palette.
Don't hardcode brand hex values inline. Wire brand tokens to the CSS custom property layer.
Don't apply font-family via style prop. Use the CSS custom properties set in index.css.
Don't design to look like Notion, Coda, Otter.ai, Fireflies, or generic SaaS cream.
Don't use emoji in UI copy or component labels.
Don't apply text-center to authenticated dashboard or list screens.
